title: Verdant Ruins: The Sentinel's Civic Seed
premise: In a forest city reclaimed by root-powered civic machines, the sentinel must escort witnesses through guarded crossings using a oath-bound signal shield.
ending: Recover the Civic Seed and return with the civilian refuge record; Green Assembly can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive spore plume while evading the canopy defender without sacrificing the civilian refuge record.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Green Assembly to witness the oath-bound signal shield.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to stand guard or pursue the artifact
